canonical_project: Lebanon Digital Acceleration Project (P506791) - government community cloud / data center investments
owner: Government of Lebanon / World Bank (OMSAR-led implementation)
notes: World Bank project approved 2026-01-26; 2026-04-28 ISR lists Component 1 Digital Foundations at USD 87.5m with indicators for government community cloud, data-center PUE, and USD 11m private capital enabled by data-center investments. SEP: private investors will deploy the government community cloud platform in new and/or rehabilitated data centers (Associated Facilities). Pipeline/planned; no public site or operator yet. National scope.
